The fixtures were released on 28 August 2026, and the season began on 24 September 2026.{{cite news |url=https://mapsport.ma/a-la-une/botola-pro-inwi-2026-2027-les-competitions-debuteront-le-24-septembre-prochain/ |title=Botola Pro « Inwi » (2026-2027): Les compétitions débuteront le 24 septembre prochain |publisher=MAP Sport |date=28 August 2026 }} [[MAS Fez]] are the [[2025-26 Botola Pro|defending champions]],{{cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co1129/morocco-botola-pro-1/records-winners-list/|title=Botola Pro 1 Winners: All Champions & Title Holders|publisher=worldfootball.net|access-date=3 September 2026}} and [[MA Tétouan]], [[WS Témara]] and [[US Amal Tiznit]] are the three newly promoted teams. ==Summary== ===Developments=== The 2026–27 season introduced several changes to the financial and administrative framework of the Botola Pro. The prize money for the champions was increased from [[Moroccan dirham|MAD]] 6 million to MAD 10 million, while the prizes for the teams finishing second through fourth were also increased. For clubs finishing from fifth to sixteenth, a new merit-based system was introduced, with financial incentives linked in part to sporting performance and the development and integration of young players. The league also introduced a digital system to monitor the playing time of players under the age of 21 through the electronic match sheet, with additional financial incentives for clubs that give greater opportunities to young players.{{cite news |url=https://medias24.com/2026/09/01/botola-pro-belkchour-devoile-le-calendrier-les-reformes-et-annonce-une-prime-de-10-mdh-pour-le-vainqueur-1746341/ |title=Botola Pro: Belkchour dévoile le calendrier, les réformes et annonce une prime de 10 MDH pour le vainqueur |publisher=Médias24 |date=1 September 2026 }}{{cite news |url=https://en.le360.ma/sports/professional-football-league-raises-botola-pro-title-prize-ahead-of-new-season_L56ARDXZMRAFXCNPCFDVUZFWUY/ |title=Professional Football League raises Botola Pro title prize ahead of new season |publisher=Le360 |date=30 August 2026 }} The league retained its 16-team format for the 2026–27 season despite proposals to expand the competition to 20 clubs.{{cite news |url=https://medias24.com/2026/08/21/football-les-championnats-professionnels-maintiennent-le-format-a-16-clubs-1742295/ |title=Football. Les championnats professionnels maintiennent le format à 16 clubs |publisher=Médias24 |date=21 August 2026 }} In addition, the LNFP adopted a medical-joker system for the season, allowing clubs to replace players in cases of medically confirmed injuries under specified conditions.{{cite news |url=https://m.elbotola.com/fr/article/2026-02-26-18-01-477.html |title=La Ligue annonce l'approbation de modifications réglementaires et légales pour garantir la régularité du Championnat professionnel |publisher=Elbotola |date=26 February 2026 }} Promotion to the top division was also made subject to compliance with the league's licensing requirements, including infrastructure, administrative management and financial conditions, rather than sporting performance alone. == Teams == A total of 16 teams will contest this league, including 13 from the [[2025-26 Botola Pro|previous edition]] and 3 teams promoted from the [[2025-26 Botola Pro 2]]. === Team changes === The following teams will
